title: Static Splayed Leg Shaving Horse
description: One newly authored complete fixed shaving-horse-inspired woodworking bench: a long chamfered sitting plank on four splayed full legs and long stretchers, a full inclined dark work bed on two fixed supports, paired whole side lever cheeks straddling the bench and joining a transverse upper clamp head to one lower foot crossbar, with fixed axle and end caps. The rear seat remains clear; the upper head is held above the inclined bed with a visible open gap. All new geometry and three opaque constant PBR roles; no old sawhorse, bench vise or irrigation treadle meshes copied or relabelled. Metres, Z up, whole bounds centred and real foot soles at Z0. One static prop, not a simulated machine: no foot actuation, clamp force, ergonomic fit, machining performance, joint load or safety claim.
